pages.title: Auto-hook
pages.text: Cada $(item)Hallucination$() dispara o sound apropriado automaticamente via $(thing)CosmicSoundManager.playForHallucination(sp, type)$().$(br2)Mapping:$(br)$(li)FAKE_WHISPER → whispers$(br)$(li)FAKE_FOOTSTEP → footsteps$(br)$(li)HEARTBEAT_PULSE → eye_pulse$(br)$(li)REVERSE_AUDIO_PULSE → radio$(br)$(li)REALITY_SHAKE → distortion

pages.title: Comando de Teste
pages.text: $(o)/liberthia sound test <type> [player]$()$(br2)Types: whispers, eye_pulse, footsteps, breathing, radio, sky_hum, tendril, distortion, scream, audience, all$(br2)$(o)all$() toca todos com 1s delay entre cada (10s total).

pages.title: Per-Player Cooldown
pages.text: Cada player tem cooldown próprio por sound type pra não spammar. Defaults:$(br2)$(li)whispers: 4s$(br)$(li)eye_pulse: 5s$(br)$(li)footsteps: 2s$(br)$(li)scream: 60s (raro)$(br)$(li)audience: 40s
